title: Close session prompt — round 2: a full-width note button, the switches out from under Tags, a plain note box

steps.headline: "+ Add a note" now spans the card with equal margins, and the two switches sit under their own label, "In your lists".
steps.changed: "+ Add a note" was a small button pushed into the card's left margin; now it is full width, the card's margins on both sides. Pin to top and Mark complete were an unlabelled card under "Tags"; now the card has its own label. Tags open, as you picked.
steps.notice: "In your lists" because both switches change how this session shows in your lists: pinned first, or hidden from Resume. The next slide offers two other places for them.
steps.risk: One more label line makes the prompt about 20 points taller.

steps.path: Close a session → Pin to top, Mark complete
steps.headline: Where should Pin to top and Mark complete sit, now that they are out from under Tags?

variants.label: One labelled card
variants.summary: "In your lists" over ONE card holding both: they are one idea, how this session shows in your lists, and the guide keeps one idea in one card. Shown on the previous slide.

variants.label: A card each
variants.summary: "Session lists" over Pin to top, "Resume list" over Mark complete: two cards, because they act on different lists. Tallest — on a 900-point screen Mark complete sits under the fade until you scroll.

variants.label: In the session's card
variants.summary: Both switches inside the session's own card, under its name and note, no label: facts about this session sit with it, like a detail page's top card. Shortest; Tags moves down.

steps.path: Close a session → + Add a note
steps.headline: The note box is now the app's plain text box: full width with even margins, upright words, three lines to start.
steps.changed: Was a one-line rounded box shifted into the card's left margin (so its right edge stopped short), in italics. Now it is the same box as the ticket's description and a quick chip's message, and it grows as you write.
steps.notice: The saved note still shows in quotes and italics under the name, as in Session details; only the box you type in changed.

steps.path: Status bar → tags element → + Add a note (also Resume, the side panel and a project's conversation)
steps.headline: Session details uses the same card, so it gets the full-width "+ Add a note" and the new note box too.
steps.changed: The name-and-note card is shared by the close prompt and Session details (status bar, Resume, the side panel, a project's conversation), so both changes appear in every one of them.
steps.notice: Nothing else in Session details changed. Say No if you want them only on the close prompt.

steps.path: Status bar → tags element → Pin to top
steps.headline: Session details has the same unlabelled Pin to top card under "Tags". Should it follow your pick for the close prompt?
steps.today: Session details (status bar, Resume, the side panel, a project's conversation) shows the Tags card with its "Tags" label, then Pin to top in a card with no label. Mark complete is not there — a session you are sitting in is not finished, so only the close prompt asks it.
steps.problem: The same thing you saw on the close prompt: an unlabelled card right under "Tags" reads as part of Tags.
steps.proposal: Use whatever you pick on the previous slide for Session details too, with Pin to top alone in it.

options.label: Follow the pick
pros: Both popups place Pin to top the same way
Pin no longer reads as a tag
cons: Session details changes again after you approved it

options.label: Leave it
pros: Session details stays exactly as approved
cons: The two popups place Pin to top differently
Pin still sits under Tags there
